verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents five official SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Java, PHP, Ruby). Each is published to its language's package registry and generated from the same OpenAPI spec as the API reference, and the docs point developers to build against the REST API or an official SDK. Missing for 10: per-SDK usage guides or code examples in the evidence, independent or hands-on confirmation that the SDKs are installable and current.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Five official SDKs. Python, TypeScript, Java, PHP and Ruby, each published to its language's package registry and generated from the same OpenAPI spec that produces this API reference.
Build against the REST API or an official SDK.
